summary.title: MLOps Course - Made With ML by Anyscale
summary.one_liner: An outline of a free MLOps course covering how to design, develop, deploy and iterate on production machine learning applications using software engineering practices.
takeaways: The course is organized into eight modules: Design, Data, Model, Develop, Utilities, Test, Reproducibility, and Production.
It teaches combining machine learning with software engineering to build production ML applications.
A live cohort version with live lessons, QA, and GPU compute is offered, with upcoming dates on the page.
Lessons are delivered via a newsletter, roughly once a month.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for the Made With ML MLOps course, presented by Anyscale. It describes the course goal of combining machine learning with software engineering to design, develop, deploy and iterate on production ML applications. The page lists eight course modules (Design, Data, Model, Develop, Utilities, Test, Reproducibility, Production) and promotes an upcoming live cohort and a newsletter. The page text gives no detail on specific tools or lesson content beyond these module titles.
